context_window.title: Context window
context_window.description: Tokens in your sessions' context window, such as 1000000. The context monitor warns at 65% and 75% of it. When sidekick's mods run, the gauge's compaction point comes first, then `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW`. The monitor stays silent when none of the three applies.
